## Orientation

Worktree ONLY for code: /home/andrewyin/se-workflow--backlog-capture
Do NOT write .artifacts/ (parent owns primary store at /home/andrewyin/se-workflow).
Do NOT call adaptive-artifacts write forms.
Wave-2 peers (parallel): skills-backlog (skills/, README), backlog-lifecycle (tests/test_backlog_item.py), dashboard-backlog (dashboard/*, dashboard tests). Do not edit each other's files. Do not edit contract/project-design.json (already landed).

Territory for this task: follow ## Approach in the work-item body only.

### Requirements
R6: The terminal dashboard shows open backlog items for the selected effort in a separate Backlog panel (not Needs you). Promote and dismiss run through the adaptive-artifacts CLI (supersede); promote also copies an agent prompt to continue in chat. Handoff still lists open items.

### Design Invariants
- Feedback never stores deferred backlog.
- Structured promote never skips discuss for a new phase.
- Every backlog-item has an effort subject that names a goal area.
- Only `status=open` active items appear in handoff and the Backlog panel.
- Needs you never lists backlog items.

### Design Assumptions
- `current-status` supersede works like assessment and goals.
- Needs you prompt-copy and CLI dismiss patterns extend cleanly to backlog actions.
- No adaptive-artifacts runtime change is required.

### Decisions
- backlog-dashboard-surface: Separate Backlog panel on the effort pane for open items
- backlog-dashboard-actions: Promote and dismiss via CLI supersede; promote copies an agent prompt
- backlog-promote: Promote closes the item and routes to discuss/new phase or incidental work-item
- backlog-item-pattern: project:backlog-item uses current-status with supersede for status
